prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1134; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash injury. The mechanism of injury described is entirely plausible for the force involved in this type of crash. Over the course of 27 visits, care included examination, targeted physical therapy, and home exercise instruction. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical spine, with reduced range of motion and paraspinal tenderness documented at initial evaluation. Treatment followed a usual and expected course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms steadily improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. No prior injury or treatment to the same body region is known to this provider. Billed services correspond to the care documented in the clinical notes, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise.
